== Summary ==
Pack art for [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]] ("18 card set"), from page 1 of the Players Committee's DefensiveShields.pdf, whose cover reads "Official text as of December 4, 2006". Cropped to the pack (945&times;1535 pixels).

Source: [http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/DefensiveShields.pdf DefensiveShields.pdf], swccgpc.com, page 1. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071028141121/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/DefensiveShields.pdf Internet Archive].

Previous version (840&times;1188, uploaded 25 September 2026, replaced 20 October 2026): [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/archive/0/00/20261020220434%21PS1-DefensiveShields-pack.png file history copy]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009222424/https://wiki.swccg.com/images/0/00/PS1-DefensiveShields-pack.png Internet Archive].
